Name: FriendshipTokens
Author: jkysa88
Description:
Friendship Tokens — Invisible Dialogue RewardsA tiny utility that lets content packs grant friendship directly from dialogue text.
Write [[FT:+250]] in a line → player sees nothing → +250 friendship is applied once for that box.

Invisible tokens: [[FT:+/-N]] or [[FT:Name:+/-N]] are stripped before rendering.

One-time per box: We sum all tokens across pages and apply once.

Targeted boosts: [[FT:Robin:+30]] raises Robin even if Shane is speaking.

Event-friendly: Works in most event speak/dialogue lines.

Multiplayer-safe: Each client applies friendship to their own farmer.

Why this is useful

No event spaghetti. No custom code. Translators and dialogue modders can tune relationship pacing right inside i18n.

Usage
Basic syntax

Current speaker: [[FT:+250]], [[FT:-40]]

Target by name: [[FT:Shane:+250]] or [[FT:Shane+250]] (case-insensitive, internal or display name)

💡 250 points = 1 heart (vanilla).

Content Patcher / i18n examples
{
"OnlyShane.sample.1": "…Fine. Take it. [[FT:+40]]",
"OnlyShane.sample.2": "Tell Robin I tried. [[FT:Robin:+20]]"
}


EditData example

{
"Action": "EditData",
"Target": "Characters/Dialogue/Shane",
"Entries": {
"Introduction": "Think you're a good friend in Stardew Valley? [[FT:+250]] [[FT:Robin:+250]]"
}
}

Event example
.../speak Shane "Okay… this is yours. [[FT:+120]]"/
message "Robin nods. [[FT:Robin:+30]]"/...


First line: +120 to the speaker (Shane).

Second line: message has no speaker, but the targeted token still grants +30 to Robin.

How it works (in short)

Tokens are removed at construction and right before rendering the text.

We sum tokens per dialogue box (across pages) and apply once:

Current-speaker tokens apply when a speaker exists.

Targeted tokens ([[FT:Name:±N]]) apply as soon as the NPC can be resolved.

UI never shows the tokens.

Limitations

No speaker = no “current speaker” bonus. Letters/TV/signs don’t have a speaker.
→ Targeted tokens still work there ([[FT:Name:+N]]), but [[FT:+N]] does not.

Mods that replace the dialogue UI with a custom class might need a small compatibility patch.

Recommended values

Small flavor line: ±10 ~ ±40

Meaningful moment: ±60 ~ ±120

Scene highlight (confession/apology): up to +250 (≈ 1 heart)

Penalties generally lower than rewards for player comfort.

Requirements

SMAPI 4.x (or newer)

Installation

Install or update SMAPI.

Drop this mod into Mods/.

Run the game. In SMAPI console you should see:

[FT] Patched N DialogueBox ctors + getCurrentString()

Compatibility & Multiplayer

Works with vanilla and CP dialogue.

Co-op: each player’s client applies friendship to their own farmer—no double-counting.

Troubleshooting

Token text appears on screen → Another UI is rendering without DialogueBox. Tell me which mod; I’ll add a hook.

Friendship didn’t change

The line had no speaker and you used [[FT:+N]] → by design. Use [[FT:Name:+N]].

Check SMAPI Trace: look for [FT] <Name> +N.

Target name not found → Use the NPC’s internal or display name (case-insensitive). The mod retries while the box is open.

FAQ

Q. Is this a cheat?
A. It’s a tool. Authors choose values. We also apply once per box to prevent abuse.

Q. Does it work in events?
A. Yes for most speak lines. message/letters/TV need targeted tokens.
